tasks.description: Hold an upright Spot posture at the current location.
Adjust Spot to the specified body height and hold upright at the current location.
Move Spot forward in its initial body-yaw direction for a bounded distance, then stop upright.
Move Spot laterally in its initial body-yaw frame for a bounded distance, then stop upright.
Move Spot's arm to the specified joint posture and hold it.
